propositions: .provision.log is an untracked and unignored provisioning artifact written to worktrees during venv creation
untracked .provision.log files prevent worktrees from being garbage collected because git status is non-empty, causing the safety guard to refuse reclamation
adding .provision.log to .gitignore at the provisioning/rebuild noise section will allow git status to be empty for worktrees with this artifact
the change is a one-line mechanical addition to .gitignore with no impact to Python source code or CLI behavior
